secrets.name: ALLOWPAY_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the AllowPay PIX payment gateway (from your AllowPay dashboard). Required for the /api/create-pix endpoint to generate PIX payments.

secrets.name: ALLOWPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign/validate AllowPay webhook callbacks (optional).

secrets.name: UTMIFY_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: API token for Utmify order tracking (from your Utmify dashboard). Optional — the API skips tracking if not set.
